reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Robotization forcing rethink of work
themes.definition: AI and robotization transforming production and threatening work, requiring rethinking of education, production processes and job preservation.
themes.inclusion: Include passages linking AI/automation to changes in work, production or employment.
themes.exclusion: Exclude generic technological-revolution statements without labour/production content.
themes.boundary_cases: Mentions of rethinking education alongside work can also be coded AI_YOUTH_EDUCATION.

examples.quote: Robotization and the accelerated process of installation of artificial intelligence force us to rethink education, production processes and the preservation of work.

themes.label: AI misuse listed among global crises
themes.definition: AI's inappropriate application named briefly within a catalogue of global problems without elaboration.
themes.inclusion: Include passages listing AI among crises such as conflict, inequality, climate change or cyberwarfare with no further discussion.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages that elaborate AI's specific risks or benefits.
themes.boundary_cases: If the list item is accompanied by a specific policy proposal on AI, code the relevant substantive theme.

examples.quote: risks of cyberwarfare and the inappropriate application of artificial intelligence

themes.label: Embedded AI values threatening democratic will
themes.definition: Concern that values trained into AI systems silently shape decisions, severing democratic accountability; the choice of values must be freedom and democracy with trainers held accountable.
themes.inclusion: Include passages arguing AI embeds its trainers' values, can covertly displace democratic decision-making, or that those training AI must be accountable.
themes.boundary_cases: Statements that AI must serve human dignity without the democracy argument go to AI_HUMAN_RIGHTS_ETHICS.

examples.quote: Like a child, artificial intelligence repeats what it has learned from those who trained it.
the will of the people risks being replaced without ever having been defeated

themes.label: AI serving human dignity
themes.definition: Ethical principle that AI must serve rather than replace human dignity.
themes.inclusion: Include statements that AI must serve human dignity or human values, including religious ethical references.
themes.exclusion: Exclude governance calls lacking an ethical principle.
themes.boundary_cases: Where dignity is invoked in a democracy-accountability argument, code both.

examples.quote: Artificial intelligence must serve human dignity and not replace it.

themes.label: Critique of UN stance on AI
themes.definition: AI's advent announced as an agenda item in a speech critical of the UN, signalling scepticism of the organisation's role on AI.
themes.inclusion: Include passages that question or criticise the UN's position or competence regarding AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude supportive statements about UN AI bodies (AI_UN_ROLE).
themes.boundary_cases: A mere agenda preview naming AI within a UN critique is coded here with low confidence.

examples.quote: third, its position in the face of the advent of artificial intelligence

value.rationale: Paraguay and Argentina passages share an 'honest diagnosis of problems' framing; AI appears as a listed crisis, a labour/production disruption, a democracy/values risk, and (Argentina 2026) as a topic in a critique of the UN.
